meta.indexing: index = row * cols + col; col = floor((lon - west) / cellSize); row = floor((north - lat) / cellSize)
meta.cellCenter: lon = west + (col + 0.5) * cellSize; lat = north - (row + 0.5) * cellSize
meta.license: Public domain / open data (SRTM, ASTER GDEM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1 等公有领域来源汇编；AWS Open Data 无使用限制)
meta.method: 每格取覆盖像素的高程中位数；relief 为该格覆盖像素高程的总体标准差；sea/lake 由地图边缘 4 邻接 flood fill 区分
